children.label: a
children.prompt: A ferry travels 32 km at a bearing of $242^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$. Calculate how far west of its departure point ($x$) the ferry has travelled.

spec.description: Southwest journey with a horizontal dashed westward leg, a right angle and a 62-degree reference angle.
spec.mathematics: Endpoint is (3 sin 242°, 3 cos 242°); horizontal leg is opposite 62°.
spec.answerVisibility: No supplied answer or O/A/H labels.

answer.worked:
Relative to $62^{\circ}$, the journey is H, the westward leg is O and the southward leg is A.
$$\begin{align*}\sin 62^{\circ}&=\frac{x}{32}\\x&=32\sin 62^{\circ}\\x&\approx28.3\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
The ferry is 28.3 km west of its departure point.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Murali is trekking for 17.4 km at a bearing of $\mathrm{N}\ 38^{\circ}\ \mathrm{E}$. Calculate how far north of his starting point, ($y$), he has travelled.

spec.description: Northeast journey, northward y leg, dashed horizontal leg and 38-degree angle at the start.
spec.mathematics: Endpoint is (3 sin 38°, 3 cos 38°); y is adjacent.
spec.answerVisibility: No supplied answer or side classifications.

answer.worked:
Relative to $38^{\circ}$, the journey is H, the northward leg is A and the eastward leg is O.
$$\begin{align*}\cos38^{\circ}&=\frac{y}{17.4}\\y&=17.4\cos38^{\circ}\\y&\approx13.7\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
Murali is 13.7 km north of his starting point.

children.prompt: Briony is competing in a 6.7 km cross country run at a bearing of $115^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$. Calculate how far east ($x$) of her starting point she is when she finishes the run.

spec.description: Southeast journey, horizontal dashed x leg and 65-degree angle from south.
spec.mathematics: Endpoint is (3 sin 115°, 3 cos 115°); x is opposite 65°.
spec.answerVisibility: No supplied answer or side classifications.

answer.worked:
Relative to $65^{\circ}$, the journey is H, the eastward leg is O and the southward leg is A.
$$\begin{align*}\sin65^{\circ}&=\frac{x}{6.7}\\x&=6.7\sin65^{\circ}\\x&\approx6.1\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
Briony finishes 6.1 km east of her starting point.

children.label: f
children.prompt: Darius walked for 4.2 km at a bearing of $285^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$ to a campsite. How far north of his starting point is the campsite?

spec.description: Unlabelled shallow northwest journey and acute angle arc from north; horizontal dashed leg and right angle.
spec.mathematics: Endpoint is (3 sin 285°, 3 cos 285°); acute angle from north is 75°.
spec.answerVisibility: Retains the source's unlabelled sides and angle.

answer.short: Reference angle $75^{\circ}$: H is the journey, A is the northward leg and O is the westward leg. $1.1\text{ km}$ north.
answer.worked:
Let $n$ be the northward distance. Relative to the angle from north, the journey is H, the northward leg is A and the westward leg is O.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=360^{\circ}-285^{\circ}=75^{\circ}\\\cos75^{\circ}&=\frac{n}{4.2}\\n&=4.2\cos75^{\circ}\\n&\approx1.1\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
The campsite is 1.1 km north of Darius's starting point.
